ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This course surveys the historical formation of gender in the social, political, and economic developments that shaped and characterized the United States to 1877. It begins with colonial contact and examines the diverse and changing meanings of gender that molded the experiences of people before and after American Independence. Throughout, we pay particular attention to the ways gender intersected with the categories of race and class as it placed women of different backgrounds in hierarchical positions.
